★Request
Display Ikuno Dictus (Casual Clothes)

★Request
Display Ikuno Dictus (Casual Clothes)

There are things one notices only when relaxing their shoulders.
Wouldn't you agree, Trainer?

On the other hand... how was it for you?
It must have been tough in parts for your first real ride.

Please look. At those beautiful fireworks.
And at this leisurely time we share.
Thank goodness... We made it in time for autumn.

Your pedaling appears to be faltering.
Is anything the matter?

The only times someone like me can slow down
are when presented with a different perspective.

That is the spirit. However, do not rush ahead too eagerly.
I will ride while keeping an eye on your condition, so let us head over at a relaxed pace.

The final day of the summer training camp. On a nearby training course,
I began timing Ikuno Dictus's run.

All that remains now is fine-tuning.
Thank you for your hard work.

Yes. The observation deck I wanted to visit is just past the nearby mountain pass.
If you would like, care to join me?

Brake for a moment. And take a deep breath!
Please try to match my speed.

It is something I rarely write down, but...
It is an unscheduled, brand-new plan.

Then let us fully look the part, shall we?
Before departing, we will loosen our muscles with some stretching.
Ah, that is right. Before I forget.

So—here is my suggestion.
Shall we head back once to pick up our bicycles?

She is being especially considerate of me today.
Ikuno Dictus is even more dependable than usual.
Let us wait for your recovery while enjoying the scenery.

Isn't it? 
Going downhill is even more exhilarating.

That is my line.
...

It seems my fundamental nature is unlikely to change.
Not in the past, and not in the future.

I would like to say yes, but... it is not so simple.
I inevitably end up prioritizing efficiency.

...Now, before rushing back on momentum, let us take a long break.
It would be nice if there were a place to sit down and rest...

Ohh... Are those the last fireworks of the summer?
How beautiful.

Ikuno Dictus had truly been looking forward to today.
However, pushing myself too hard would only cause her more trouble.
Haaaaaaahhhhhーー!!!!

At the end of a forest trail branching off the pass road, I spotted a signboard.
If my eyes didn't deceive me, the letters spelled out "CAFE."

In other words... I would appreciate it if you could continue
to pump the brakes for me in the future.

Physical condition is fully normal... Check.
The mountain pass is a battle of stamina. Overexertion is strictly prohibited, after all.

Splendid.
Let us gradually build up your stamina toward our eventual rematch.
"Someday, let us go on a long ride together again."

No, no, please do not apologize.
I thoroughly enjoyed our ride together for the first time in a while.

Had I simply pushed forward, I likely would have overlooked this.
In fact, I would never have even known it existed.

Oh, look between the mountains... the town.
It looks picturesque enough to be a postcard.
Trainer, that is not at all――

.
Did you sleep well last night?

As I started pedaling, the bicycle glided forward with astonishing smoothness.
With light feet, I inadvertently picked up speed――

Just then, fireworks burst into view through the window.
They radiated light brilliant enough to obscure the city glow.

That was something I had once taught Ikuno Dictus myself.
Even though I should have known it in my head...

*Haah*, *haah*... *haah*...
Trainer... what do you think?
...There, all done.

...I do not regret being unable to reach
the observation deck today.

With a resounding boom, another firework burst in the sky.
No matter how many times I see it, it is breathtaking—a sight I'd love to watch with her again and again.
Fufu. This time, it was your turn to notice.

...The summer breeze and scent feel lovely.
How are you doing, Trainer?
...*Phew*. All my fatigue simply melts away.

I ended up soaking in the scenery for quite a long time.
...I wonder if the view from the observation deck would have been just as beautiful.

After cycling the mountain pass in high spirits for 30 minutes.
We were close to the observation deck, but my pace began to slow down――

...*Phew*.
The steep mountain pass begins here. Are you mentally prepared?

Ah, Trainer. There you are.
Tomorrow is a spare day, so you have no scheduled plans, correct?

No wonder... I should have noticed sooner.
How severe is the pain? Do you think you can ride after taking a rest?
